h1: Autonomous AI Agents Running 24/7 Across Zimbabwe
sub: Empower your enterprise with AI agents on dedicated cloud computers that operate uninterrupted, even during power or internet outages.
audience: Commercial farmers, mining contractors, software developers, regional cross-border traders, logistics dispatchers, and Harare financial consultants.
manifesto: When unpredictable power outages and connection cuts threaten business momentum, Ceyo keeps your operations running uninterrupted on isolated cloud computers, handling browser research, coding, spreadsheets, and client messaging without missing a beat.

uses.d: Track international auction benchmarks and freight quotes across global portals automatically to optimize export margins for Harare flower and fruit growers.
Scrape regional supplier catalogs and fill procurement RFQs automatically to source heavy machinery parts across Southern Africa.
Connect spreadsheets, email receipts, and driver status updates via Telegram group chats to oversee logistics between Harare, Bulawayo, and Beitbridge.
Deploy autonomous coding agents that write, execute, and test backend code inside remote Linux cloud environments without draining your battery.
Run scheduled morning routines synthesizing global commodity shifts, market indexes, and trade announcements into comprehensive executive briefs.
Deliver instant voice and text interactions for clients across time zones using multi-agent Telegram bots sharing institutional memory.

steps.d: Select your plan and start your 3-day free trial to spin up your dedicated cloud environment.
Connect your email, spreadsheets, or Telegram groups and assign specific research, coding, or monitoring tasks.
Let your bots run 24/7 in the cloud, autonomously executing complex workflows even when your local devices are offline.

chapters.d: Before the Harare workday begins, your agent browses international commodity exchanges and sends a summarized digest directly to Telegram. Key pricing alerts for agricultural and mineral exports are neatly organized in your connected Google Sheets.

While you head between meetings along Samora Machel Avenue, your coding agent builds and tests API integrations on its isolated cloud computer. It commits clean code and alerts your engineering team once automated checks pass.

Your logistics agent visits multiple supplier portals across the region to extract quotes for heavy spares. It auto-fills requisition web forms and logs transaction milestones using its built-in crypto wallet.

Even if local power or fiber drops at home, your cloud agents continue monitoring client inquiries and answering calls. You wake up to structured daily logs, fully confident that no operational cycle stalled.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 tokens per day. A card is linked upon registration and charged only when the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Do my bots stop working if my local power or internet goes out?
faq.a: No, every Ceyo bot runs inside its own isolated 24/7 cloud computer in secure data centers. Your scheduled routines, browser automations, and coding tasks continue uninterrupted even if your phone or computer loses power and connection.

faq.q: Can I manage and collaborate with my bots using Telegram?
faq.a: Yes, Ceyo connects seamlessly with Telegram, allowing you to interact with individual bots or introduce them into group chats. Multiple specialist bots can collaborate together in your team chats to handle support, research, and technical tasks.
Ceyo agents are fully proficient in English and can process, analyze, and communicate in dozens of world languages, facilitating smooth cross-border business communications and local interactions.

faq.q: What applications can Ceyo integrate with?
faq.a: Ceyo integrates with more than 1,000 popular applications, including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, calendars, and enterprise CRMs, allowing your bots to read, update, and manage your data automatically.
